params.fair_value: VWAP of the last 60 minutes, known at t-1
params.sigma: std of 1-min log returns over trailing min(1440, minutes since t0), x sqrt(60), known at t-1
params.tp: post-only at 60% of the way back to F
params.time_exit: market at the open of the first traded minute after t+30
params.ai_filter: walk-forward LightGBM (edge.wick.PARAMS, 250 rounds, seeds 7/11/23) by quarter from 2022Q3, trained on candidates before quarter start - 1 day incl. 2024 listings; label = net bp at 2x costs of min($3K, 0.5 x through-volume); keep if prediction > median training prediction; features: days since listing, drawdown from first-day VWAP, 24h volume vs day 1, BTC 60-min move, sigma, k-depth bp

selection: highest DEV alpha t among trials with >= 40 trades (reports/hunt/h4nl/trials_dev.csv, 15 trials)
